text.tspan: Three ways to split one model across GPUs
GPUs pass work along like a relay
Best for: models too big for 1 machine
Each token uses only a few experts
The new bottleneck to avoid: GPU-to-GPU communication.
Split too much, or over slow links, and the GPUs spend their time waiting instead of computing.
